measures.notes: EIA Updated Buildings Sector Equipment Costs 2023 (base 2022$), commercial rooftop heat pump tiers, Appendix A. Per-unit total installed cost, PRIMARY-EXTRACTED.

ACEEE Summer Study 2016 paper 3-345: VRF ~$18/ft2 vs code-min baseline $12-15/ft2 (PRIMARY-DOC/summary). low/high derived as a +/-3 spread around the reported $18/ft2 anchor (no explicit VRF-specific range in source) -- tuned-base band, flag for tightening against a real VRF-specific range.

SECONDARY sanity-band only (GeothermalFinder/EnergySage 2025-26 guides), office tier $4,500-7,500/ton (loop drilling = 50-70% of vertical closed-loop cost). EIA (2022$) and ORNL GeoVision (2019, ORNL/TM-2019/502) carry authoritative commercial GSHP figures, but a specific $/ton was not extracted from those PDFs in this pass -- flagged for ingest. source: tuned-base.

EIA 2023 study, base 2022$, centrifugal/screw/scroll chillers, $440-1390/ton total installed across capacity/efficiency tiers, PRIMARY-EXTRACTED. Underlying per-unit values are derived from proprietary RSMeans 2023 + Guidehouse; citing only EIA's published aggregation (public domain).

SECONDARY trade sanity band (Oxmaint 2026), mid-size commercial condensing boiler (1-3 MMBtu) installed cost. EIA carries an authoritative per-unit boiler figure in its Appendix A ('Commercial Gas-Fired Boilers'), but the specific $/unit was not extracted in this pass -- flagged for ingest. source: tuned-base.

like_for_like.basis: standard non-condensing commercial gas boiler (code-minimum replacement)
like_for_like.note: Oxmaint 2026 reports a condensing upgrade premium of ~$6-10K/unit over a standard replacement; like-for-like = condensing base - that premium, so incremental (premium only) = ~$6/8/10K per unit. Apply the incremental as the CapEx basis ONLY when the existing boiler is at/near end-of-life (per the asset's Audette RUL); for a healthy boiler the full capex is incremental.

measures.notes: PNNL-21944 (Oct 2012, DOE Contract DE-AC05-76RL01830), office-building scenario: maximum installed controller cost per packaged unit yielding a 3-yr payback, $1,560-2,990/RTU, PRIMARY-EXTRACTED. These are 'max acceptable for 3-yr payback' figures, not mean market bid prices -- treat as an upper-bound-anchored band; retail-building tier ($4,180-8,390/RTU) was not seeded separately.

LBNL (Mills, Building Commissioning: A Golden Opportunity, 2009), existing-buildings RCx: median ~$0.30/ft2, range $0.05-0.40/ft2, PRIMARY-DOC/summary, 2009$. ~16% energy savings, payback ~1.1yr reported alongside.

LBNL Mills & Sartor, Energy Use and Savings Potential for Laboratory Fume Hoods (OSTI 862161, 2006): CAV->VAV retrofit ~$6,000/hood, mid-2000s $, PRIMARY-DOC/summary; retrofit kits reported at 10-20% of a new hood's cost. low/high derived as a +/-20% band around the reported $6,000 anchor (source gives a single point figure) -- tuned-base band.

DOE Building America, Cost Analysis of Roof-Only Air Sealing and Insulation Strategies: roof air-seal+insulation to R-20 ~$10.25-20/ft2 roof area, PRIMARY-DOC/summary. Source scope is RESIDENTIAL; applied here as a commercial tuned-base proxy pending a commercial-specific envelope survey. Base year is not explicitly stated in the source; a conservative 2015 Building America-era vintage is assumed pending verification -- flag.

SECONDARY trade guide (HireElectrical / National Efficiency Supply 2026), commercial LED retrofit $0.50-5.00/ft2. No authoritative redistributable commercial LED $/ft2 survey was found in this research pass (DOE SSL/CALiPER, GSA Green Proving Ground, and utility TRMs are flagged for future ingest). source: tuned-base.

SECONDARY trade guide (eilitetech), example 75HP VFD install $12k-18k implies ~$160-240/HP. The $80-250/HP figure elsewhere in the source is a utility prescriptive REBATE, not an install cost, and was deliberately excluded. No authoritative installed-cost survey was found; DOE UMP Ch.18 is an M&V protocol, not a cost source. source: tuned-base.

CED Engineering, HVAC -- Guide to Demand Control Ventilation (course monograph, PRIMARY-DOC/summary): DCV adds ~$1-3/cfm of outside air; CO2 sensors now <$200 (was >$500 a decade ago). Base year not stated in source; conservatively dated 2015 pending verification -- flag. ERV/HRV per-unit costs ($4k-20k+/unit, SECONDARY sanity band only, no clean $/cfm survey) were not seeded separately; utility TRMs (IL, CA DEER, NY) are the recommended authoritative substitute per the research doc.
